ERR_CONFIG_01.title: Missing configuration file
ERR_CONFIG_01.description: The OpenClaw configuration file (openclaw.config.json or .openclawrc) was not found.
fixSteps: Check if openclaw.config.json exists in your project root
Run 'openclaw init' to generate a default configuration
Verify the OPENCLAW_CONFIG environment variable points to the correct path

ERR_CONFIG_02.title: Invalid configuration syntax
ERR_CONFIG_02.description: The configuration file contains invalid JSON or unsupported fields.
fixSteps: Validate your configuration file with 'openclaw config validate'
Check for trailing commas or missing quotes in JSON
Compare against the default config template in the docs

ERR_CONFIG_03.title: Missing required configuration field
ERR_CONFIG_03.description: A required field is missing from the configuration.
fixSteps: Check that 'name' and 'version' fields are present in your config
Ensure all required skill references include a valid path
Run 'openclaw config validate' to see which fields are missing

ERR_SKILL_01.title: Skill not found
ERR_SKILL_01.description: The referenced skill could not be located in the skills directory or registry.
fixSteps: Verify the skill name is spelled correctly in your configuration
Check that the skill is installed: 'openclaw skill list'
Install the skill: 'openclaw skill install <skill-name>'

ERR_SKILL_02.title: Skill SKILL.md missing or invalid
ERR_SKILL_02.description: The skill's SKILL.md file is missing required frontmatter or has invalid format.
fixSteps: Ensure SKILL.md exists in the skill root directory
Add required YAML frontmatter with 'name' and 'description' fields
Validate frontmatter syntax using 'openclaw skill validate <path>'

ERR_SKILL_03.title: Skill script execution failed
ERR_SKILL_03.description: A script referenced in the skill failed to execute.
fixSteps: Check that the script file exists and has execute permissions
Verify Node.js version compatibility (requires >= 18)
Run the script manually to see the full error output
Check for missing dependencies with 'npm install'

ERR_AGENT_01.title: Agent session spawn failed
ERR_AGENT_01.description: Failed to spawn a new agent session.
fixSteps: Check that the OpenClaw daemon is running: 'openclaw status'
Verify available system resources (memory and CPU)
Restart the agent service: 'openclaw agent restart'
Check session limits in configuration

ERR_AGENT_02.title: Agent communication timeout
ERR_AGENT_02.description: The agent session timed out waiting for a response.
fixSteps: Increase the timeout value in your configuration
Check network connectivity between agent components
Verify the target service is running and responsive
Review agent logs for detailed timeout information

ERR_AGENT_03.title: Agent crashed unexpectedly
ERR_AGENT_03.description: The agent process terminated with an unhandled error.
fixSteps: Check agent logs at ~/.openclaw/logs/agent.log
Look for out-of-memory conditions in system logs
Update OpenClaw to the latest version
Run 'openclaw agent diagnose' for detailed crash analysis

ERR_SIGNAL_01.title: Process killed by signal
ERR_SIGNAL_01.description: The process received a kill signal (SIGTERM/SIGKILL).
fixSteps: Check if the system OOM killer terminated the process
Increase memory limits in your configuration
Monitor resource usage during execution
Check for conflicting processes on the same port

ERR_MEMORY_07.title: Out of memory
fixSteps: Increase Node.js heap size: --max-old-space-size=4096
Check for memory leaks in long-running agent sessions
Reduce concurrent session count in configuration
Monitor memory usage with 'openclaw metrics'

ERR_INSTALL_01.title: Installation failed - missing Node.js
ERR_INSTALL_01.description: Node.js is not installed or version is incompatible.
fixSteps: Install Node.js >= 18 from https://nodejs.org
Use nvm to manage Node.js versions: 'nvm install 18'
Verify installation: 'node --version'

ERR_INSTALL_02.title: npm dependency resolution failed
ERR_INSTALL_02.description: npm could not resolve one or more dependencies.
fixSteps: Clear npm cache: 'npm cache clean --force'
Delete node_modules and package-lock.json, then 'npm install'
Check for conflicting peer dependency versions
Try using '--legacy-peer-deps' flag

ERR_PERMISSION_01.title: Permission denied
ERR_PERMISSION_01.description: Insufficient permissions to access a file or directory.
fixSteps: Check file ownership: 'ls -la <path>'
Fix permissions: 'chmod 755 <directory>' or 'chmod 644 <file>'
Avoid running with sudo - fix the underlying permission issue instead
Check if SELinux or AppArmor is blocking access

ERR_NETWORK_01.title: Network connection failed
ERR_NETWORK_01.description: Could not establish a network connection to the required service.
fixSteps: Check internet connectivity
Verify proxy settings in environment variables
Check if a firewall is blocking outbound connections
Test the endpoint directly: 'curl -v <url>'

ERR_NETWORK_02.title: API rate limit exceeded
ERR_NETWORK_02.description: Too many requests to the API in a short time period.
fixSteps: Wait for the rate limit window to reset
Implement request throttling in your agent configuration
Check for runaway loops making excessive API calls
Contact support if the rate limit seems too restrictive

ERR_SESSION_01.title: Session state corrupted
ERR_SESSION_01.description: The agent session state file is corrupted or inconsistent.
fixSteps: Clear the session cache: 'openclaw session clear'
Delete the session state directory: ~/.openclaw/sessions/
Restart the agent with a fresh session
Check disk space - corruption often occurs when disk is full

ERR_SESSION_02.title: Maximum sessions exceeded
ERR_SESSION_02.description: The maximum number of concurrent sessions has been reached.
fixSteps: Close unused sessions: 'openclaw session list' then 'openclaw session close <id>'
Increase max_sessions in your configuration
Check for orphaned sessions that should have been cleaned up

ERR_TOOL_01.title: Tool execution failed
ERR_TOOL_01.description: A tool call within the agent workflow failed to execute.
fixSteps: Verify the tool is properly registered in the agent configuration
Check tool dependencies are installed
Review tool input parameters for type mismatches
Run the tool in isolation to reproduce the error

ERR_TOOL_02.title: Tool not found
ERR_TOOL_02.description: The referenced tool is not registered or available.
fixSteps: Check tool name spelling in your skill configuration
Verify the tool plugin is installed: 'openclaw tool list'
Install the missing tool: 'openclaw tool install <name>'
Check that tool permissions are configured correctly
